Dhurandhar box-office report: Ranveer Singh-Akshaye Khannas spy thriller is the highest-grossing Bollywood film of 2025, all set to break Pathaans global record

Synopsis
Dhurandhar, starring Ranveer Singh, is a box office sensation. The film continues its strong performance well into its fourth week. It has achieved impressive domestic earnings and crossed Rs 1,051 crore globally. Theatre occupancy remains high, reflecting sustained audience interest. Dhurandhar is now the highest-grossing release of 2025 so far.
Agencies
Sara Arjun and Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar
Listen to this article in summarized format
Listen
Ranveer Singhs espionage thriller Dhurandhar continues to dominate the box office well into its fourth week, defying the usual slowdown seen after the initial rush. According to data shared by box-office tracking platform
Sacnilk,
the film added an impressive Rs 20.9 crore to its domestic earnings on its fourth Saturday alone. This surge pushed the India net total to Rs 706.40 crore. The upward trend continued on Sunday as well, with the film collecting an additional Rs 22.25 crore, reinforcing its remarkable theatrical run.

Remove Ads
Strong Worldwide Numbers Cement Global Success
Beyond domestic markets, Dhurandhar has also delivered extraordinary results overseas. Within just 23 days of release, the film crossed the Rs 1,026 crore mark globally. Trade estimates indicate that the worldwide total has now moved beyond Rs 1,051 crore, as reported by Bollywood Hungama. These numbers place the Ranveer Singh-led project firmly among the
highest-grossing Indian films
of all time, especially within the action and spy genre.
Theatre Occupancy Reflects Sustained Audience Interest
Audience turnout remains healthy across cinema halls. On Saturday, the film recorded an overall Hindi occupancy of 38.48 per cent. Morning shows opened at a modest 20.54 per cent, but footfalls rose significantly as the day progressed. Evening shows registered 45.34 per cent occupancy, while night screenings followed closely at 42.27 per cent, indicating strong word-of-mouth and repeat viewership.
Breaking Records and Chasing Bigger Milestones
In terms of India net collections, Dhurandhar has already surpassed Prabhas Kalki 2898 AD, which concluded its run at Rs 646.31 crore domestically. The film is now steadily closing in on Shah Rukh Khans Pathaan, which amassed approximately Rs 1,055 crore worldwide.  As per a Bollywood Hungama report, the movie has amassed a collection of Rs 1051 crore already at the box-office. It is also locked in competition with Pushpa 2, whose Hindi version collected Rs 812.14 crore. Industry trackers confirm that Dhurandhar has emerged as the highest-grossing release of 2025 so far, outperforming titles like Kantara: Chapter 1 and Chhaava.

Film Overview and Creative Vision
Released in 2025, Dhurandharwhich translates to Stalwartis a Hindi-language spy action thriller helmed by Aditya Dhar, who also served as writer and co-producer. Backed by
Jyoti
Deshpandes Jio Studios along with B62 Studios, the film features an ensemble cast including Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, R. Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sara Arjun and Rakesh Bedi, supported by several familiar faces.
As the first chapter in a planned two-part series, the narrative follows a covert anti-terror mission involving an undercover operative navigating Karachis criminal and political networks. The storyline draws inspiration from multiple real-world geopolitical incidents, blending fiction with historical undertones to heighten its impact.
